verdict.rationale: a-Shell is an iOS Unix-like terminal, so biometric protection of remote connections is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack never mentions Face ID, Touch ID, fingerprint authentication, or biometric-gated SSH keys. The items cover languages, appearance, Shortcuts, pickFolder and packages, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can protect my remote connections with biometric authentication like Face ID or fingerprint
